open_points.subject: FlowActivation action for effectful flow versions
open_points.text: "activate a flow | agent asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once, the owner activates any other"
open_points.question: When an agent calls activate on a proven non-read-only flow version, what concrete product action result exists in State 1: refusal, deferred owner task, or immediate owner-side activation path?
options: Refuse the agent call and require a separate owner activate call
Create a pending owner-activation request model/state
Allow the same call to proceed only when authenticated as owner
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the agent call for non-read-only versions and require an explicit owner activation call.

open_points.subject: OperationBinding acceptance after manifest drift
open_points.text: "When the record's digest no longer matches, invocation is refused until a new binding is accepted" + "accept a binding | owner | accepted binding; accepting an accepted binding returns it"
open_points.question: If the manifest record changed after proposal but before owner acceptance, is accepting that stale proposal allowed or refused?
options: Allow acceptance; binding becomes accepted but invocation will refuse until reproposed/accepted against current digest
Refuse acceptance when current manifest digest no longer matches the proposal pin
open_points.default_guess: Allow acceptance (pin is part of the binding identity), with invocation refusal until a new binding is accepted.

open_points.subject: TrialCase capture from a released failed run
open_points.text: "capture a failed execution into the trial corpus" + "a `failed` run, whose spool stays until the owner or an agent releases the run"
open_points.question: After a failed run is released (spool removed), can its failed function execution still be captured into TrialCase, especially when inputs included files?
options: Allow capture only when all needed inputs are still representable without spool files
Allow capture always from trace references

open_points.subject: StandingGrant applicability to node effect classes
open_points.text: "grant or revoke a standing approval for a node of a flow's active version" + "each `state-transition`, `external-effect` and `destructive` node stops for the owner's approval"
open_points.question: Can a standing grant be created for `read` or `draft-write` operation nodes that never require per-run approval?
options: Refuse grant on nodes that do not require approval
Allow grant but it is inert/no-op
Allow only for approval-requiring classes (`state-transition`, `external-effect`), refuse others; `destructive` already forbidden
open_points.default_guess: Allow only for approval-requiring non-destructive classes; refuse `read` and `draft-write`.

open_points.subject: StandingGrant behavior when flow version is no longer active
open_points.text: "at most one active grant exists for one node of one flow version" + "a new activation replaces the previous one at once"
open_points.question: Does an active grant remain active while its flow version is inactive and become effective again if that version is reactivated, or is it auto-revoked on deactivation?
options: Grant remains active until explicit revoke, regardless of current flow activation
Grant is automatically revoked when the flow version stops being active
open_points.default_guess: Grant remains active until explicit revoke.

open_points.subject: StandingGrant re-grant after revoke
open_points.question: If the owner grants again for the same node/version after revocation, is that a new StandingGrant entity (new grant_id) or reactivation of the revoked one?
options: Create a new grant entity with a new grant_id
Reopen/reactivate the previously revoked grant entity
open_points.default_guess: Create a new grant entity with a new grant_id.
